From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Payment routing fallback and VAT anchoring issue - HelixCloud remittance

Hi Claire / Helix billing team,

Quick heads up — during our September billrun we saw a handful of payments that followed a fallback routing rule (your PSP retry window) and landed as credit notes against a holding entity instead of applying to the active invoice entity. That caused VAT anchoring to misalign for four invoices in the EU cohort (invoice IDs embedded in the remittance).

Attached: remittance_20260903.csv (extract), I started a quick trace (orphan-credit-trace.xlsx) showing the affected invoice numbers and posted credit IDs. Can you confirm:
- whether the PSP re-route to the holding account was intentional for those card declines?
- full remittance file with payment_to_invoice mapping (we only have partial)

This is blocking our month-end AR close for HelixCloud (they're a mid-size EU account). Grace/Marcus: I think we should prepare a short playbook for ledger-side repairs and a fallback routing change so this doesn't reoccur. Laura — will need a GL correction and journal template if we make a manual apply.

Next steps I propose: Claire to confirm remittance mapping; Redwood to produce journal suggestion + canary revert for routing; then coordinate a same-day correction if mapping is clean.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
From: Claire Moreno <cmoreno@helixcloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: remittances@helixcloud.com
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 17:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Payment routing fallback and VAT anchoring issue - HelixCloud remittance

Hi Jordan — thanks for the flag and the trace. Apologies for the confusion.

We ran a retry batch on 2026-09-03 that pushed some settlements through our backup routing when the primary PSP reported an invalid merchant reference. That should not have created holding-entity credits, but I can see in our ledger that when the merchant reference didn't match the expected entity tag, our passthrough logic posted the settlement to a legacy holding account.

I've attached the full remittance mapping (attached: remittance_20260903.csv) showing payment -> posted_credit_id and the original invoice reference where present. For the four items you flagged, the original invoice references are partial / truncated in our file. We're extracting the full payment trail from the acquiring bank and expect a complete file by 2026-09-09 COB UTC.

Immediate mitigation we can do from our side: add a strict matching rule on merchant_ref length and route unmatched ones to a review queue instead of the holding account. We can also provide a corrected remittance for manual apply.

Let me know if you want the corrected mapping as a CSV or if your AP/Finance prefer a fixed format for automated ingest.

Claire
Billing Operations Manager, HelixCloud
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment routing fallback and VAT anchoring issue - HelixCloud remittance

Thanks Claire — that helps. I'm looping in Laura to prepare the GL-side steps. High-level finance approach from our side:

1) Wait for HelixCloud final remittance (expected 2026-09-09 COB UTC).
2) Prepare two-part correction: (A) reverse the credits posted to the holding account, (B) re-apply funds to the correct invoice entities with original VAT tags intact.
3) For any items where Helix cannot provide a reliable invoice ref, we'll escalate to a temporary unapplied-credit bucket with a note for tax (EU VAT) review and provide a list of impacted customers for outreach.

Marcus — please pull the posting history for the holding GL 2100-HOLD for the period 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-04 and export JV lines. Laura, attached is a draft of the journal templates we will need (orphan-credit-trace.xlsx has suggested JV lines).

Operational asks:
- Marcus: export JV lines and confirm balances by EOD 2026-09-09 PT.
- Laura: prepare tapping journal and a one-click reversal template we can run after Claire confirms mapping. Also include a tax memo stub for VAT team.

We should avoid backdating revenue recognition adjustments if possible; prefer re-allocations that keep recognize timing intact. If any re-allocations cross fiscal periods, flag for revenue ops.

Grace
Finance Lead, AR Operations
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Moreno <cmoreno@helixcloud.com>, remittances@helixcloud.com

Subject: Re: Payment routing fallback and VAT anchoring issue - HelixCloud remittance

Claire — appreciate the quick turnaround and the confirmed remediation path.

Laura and Marcus: Per Grace's plan, please run the JV export and prep the reversal/apply scripts. I've uploaded our proposed playbook and the one-click reversal PDF to the shared drive (link in metadata). If Helix posts the full payment trail by COB UTC tomorrow we can schedule the correction on 2026-09-11 (non-business hours) with a rollback window.

Action summary:
- Helix: send full payment trail (expected 2026-09-09 COB UTC).
- Marcus: JV export for GL 2100-HOLD by EOD 2026-09-09 PT.
- Laura: journal templates and tax memo stub ready by 2026-09-10 17:00 PT.
- Jordan: coordinate cutover and post-checks; I'll run a sample apply on a single invoice once Helix confirms mapping.

References: attached ar-routing-playbook-v1.2.pdf (playbook with rollback steps).

If anything changes on the Helix timeline call it out in HS-53472 so the CS and revenue ops teams are aligned.

Thanks everyone — Jordan
